headline: GPT-6 Astra model now available on OpenRouter
summary: OpenAI's flagship model for demanding end-to-end work is now accessible via OpenRouter, with flexible provider routing and detailed performance metrics.
details: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra, designed for advanced analysis, software engineering, deep research, and document creation, is now available through OpenRouter. This model excels at long-horizon agentic tasks requiring computer and browser interaction.

OpenRouter offers flexible routing options for GPT-6 Astra, including 'Balanced' (price + speed), 'Nitro' (fastest), and 'Exacto' (highest tool-calling accuracy). This allows users to optimize for their specific needs, whether it's cost-efficiency, speed, or precision.

The model supports a massive 1,050,000 token context window and up to 128,000 completion tokens. It also features robust function calling capabilities with tool and tool_choice support, and can output structured data via JSON schema.

GPT-6 Astra can process various file types, including PDFs, images, and text, returning text outputs. This makes it versatile for tasks involving document analysis, data extraction, and content generation.

Pricing for GPT-6 Astra on OpenRouter is set at $10.00/M input tokens and $50.00/M output tokens. Additional rates apply for Cache Read ($1.00/M tokens), Cache Write ($12.50/M tokens), and Web Search ($10.00/1K calls).

OpenRouter provides real-time performance metrics, including throughput (tokens per second), latency, and time-to-first-token (TTFT), enabling users to monitor and optimize model performance. Uptime and availability figures are also continuously tracked.

GPT-6 Astra is served by two providers on OpenRouter: OpenAI and Azure (US). The platform ensures high availability through automatic failover to healthy providers when errors occur, with options for users to pin or exclude specific providers.
